newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amalia gets 9.56 mln rand, shrs for sales.
newsitem.headline: Amalia gets 9.56 mln rand, shrs for sales.

text.p: Amalia Gold Mining and Exploration Co said on Friday it would receive a cash payment of 9.5625 million rand and 62.5 million ordinary shares in London-based Commonwealth Gold Plc (Comgold) for the sale of Zimvest Holdings Est Triesen and Minehead Mining Ltd.

The sales of Liechtenstein-registered Zimvest and Zimbabwe-based Moorhead to Comgold for a total consideration of 57.375 million rand at an exchange rate of 7.65 rand to sterling, was announced in April.
The shares would be placed at a price of 10 pence a share which was prevailing at the time of the transaction. This was equivalent to 89.1 cents per Amalia share.
